title: AccountKillSwitchWorkflowInput
description: Phase 6: input for AccountKillSwitchWorkflow. ONE workflow per tenant_id (NO strategy_id segment — the cap spans every strategy on the tenant's shared broker_target), bootstrapped on orchestrator startup with workflow_id t-<tenant>/account/killswitch. Mirrors KillSwitchWorkflowInput's carry-forward shape for continueAsNew. Fresh bootstrap inputs omit the carry-forward fields; replayed continueAsNew inputs populate them.

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. v1 = bootstrap-only input; v2 adds optional carry-forward fields produced by continueAsNew. Workers reject newer-than-build inputs.

tripped.description: Carry-forward state from a prior run. Absent on fresh bootstrap. Default false.

reason.description: Carry-forward trip reason from a prior run. Absent on fresh bootstrap.

actor.description: Carry-forward trip actor from a prior run. Absent on fresh bootstrap.

tripped_at.description: Carry-forward trip timestamp from a prior run. Absent on fresh bootstrap.

cooling_down_until.description: Carry-forward reset cooldown deadline from a prior run. Absent on fresh bootstrap.

trading_day.description: Carry-forward trading day from a prior run. Absent on fresh bootstrap; next heartbeat refreshes via calendar.todayEt().
